settings.name: The Rojas family
settings.text: Three generations growing coffee on steep, shaded slopes.

settings.heading: Brewing tips
settings.text: Use fresh, filtered water just off the boil and about 60 g of coffee per litre.

settings.heading: Delivery and returns
settings.text: Shipped within two days of roasting. If something is not right, tell us and we will make it right.
